name: Behringer AKS mini
note: A synth, not an interface: its USB carries power and MIDI, and its sound leaves by a 3.5 mm headphone jack, so record it by cabling that jack into an interface's input. The MIDI name to match is a guess; its USB id is not captured.

ports.label: PHONES
ports.about: 3.5 mm stereo headphone output: its only audio output. Cable it into an interface's input to record it.

ports.label: MIDI IN
ports.about: 5-pin DIN MIDI in, and MIDI over USB: notes, and NRPN/CC for every parameter.

ports.label: MIDI OUT
ports.about: MIDI over USB: its keys, and CCs as its controls move.

ports.label: USB-C
ports.about: 5 V power and USB MIDI. No USB audio is listed by Behringer or its dealers.

hardware.extending: A 3-voice analog synth after the EMS Synthi AKS. It sends MIDI to the Pi over USB, so the rig sees it as a MIDI device and can record its notes beside a take; its sound has to come in through an interface (the AMS-24's inputs, or a Sidekick strip). Fill this in from the real unit: confirm the MIDI port name (match.midi), confirm there is no USB audio, then flip statuses. Everything under "hardware" is ignored by the Go loader: it is notes for people, and for a later registry (docs/hardware/README.md, Later: sharing profiles). To fill this profile from a real unit, follow 'Capturing an unknown device' in docs/hardware/README.md, then flip statuses from 'unconfirmed' or 'to-capture' to 'owner'.

connection.note: Plugged into the jam-space Pi over USB (Oct 2026); it sends MIDI.

audio.outputs: One 3.5 mm stereo headphone output; dealers list no line outputs and no digital output.
audio.usb_audio: None listed by Behringer or by dealers (USB-C is given as power and MIDI).
audio.engine: 3 VCOs (saw and square, with shape), analog low-pass filter with resonance, LFO, envelope, digital spring reverb; poly and unison modes.
audio.$comment: Unconfirmed because no maker's spec table was found. arecord -l with it plugged in settles it.

midi.implementation: NRPN and CC for all parameters (Behringer's page).

controls.keyboard: 27 touch keys (Behringer calls them touch-sensitive; a dealer lists aftertouch and no velocity).
controls.other: Two-axis joystick, 16-step motion sequencer with parameter recording, arpeggiator, display.
controls.$comment: Read the panel off the unit before drawing a labelled diagram.

quirks.text: Its only audio output is a headphone jack: set its level so the interface input doesn't clip.
